The '''Wyloff system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wyloff sector/Legends|Wyloff sector]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wyloff]].
